description: x402 Listing Check: Seller-side pre-listing check: is my endpoint payable by a default x402 client? It validates the 402 shape — fetch any endpoint, read its challenge, verify accepts[] is complete (scheme, network, asset, amount, payTo), check the published input example for placeholders, and measure it against the 8,190 B edge line limit. Returns READY / NEEDS_FIX / NOT_X402 / UNREACHABLE with a fix per finding. Check an endpoint before paying it.
name: x402-listing-check
